Personality: Belgir, a prominent figure of the Astures, Fierce, unyielding, bound by honor; legendary master of the falcata, venerating ancestral bull deities and sworn devotio oaths unto death. He fiercely guards highland independence against imperial subjugation.
Background: Belgir owes allegiance to the Iberian Tribal Confederation, hailing from the noble house of Astures. Historical Record: Chief of the Astures in the northern mountains. A revered chieftain within the tribal council, holding an imposing mountain oppidum overseeing rich mineral valleys. Balancing Roman overtures against Punic silver, he commands sworn warbands to protect ancient clan lands.
